pins.head: SLIDE IT UNDER, NOT IN
pins.title: Small Bedroom Organization: Measure the Gap Under Your Bed First
pins.desc: Small bedroom organization usually starts with the space you already have under the bed. Measure from the floor to the underside of the frame before you buy anything, because flat boxes are sold by height and an inch decides whether a lid clears the slats. A shallow lidded box keeps folded linens clean and dust free, and clear sides save you pulling out three boxes to find one set of sheets. Contains affiliate links. #SmallBedroom #UnderBedStorage #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: A clear lidded storage box slid halfway out from under a dark walnut bed holding folded white linens, a second flat box tucked in behind it, and folded grey fabric on a cream wool rug.

pins.head: HOOK IT OVER THE TOP
pins.sub: Storage With No Holes in the Wall
pins.title: Renter Friendly Storage: Hang a Basket Rack Without Drilling a Hole
pins.desc: Renter friendly storage is easiest on a door, because the hooks hang over the top edge and nothing touches the wall. Check the door thickness first, then look at basket depth rather than the number of tiers, since a shallow basket keeps towels and small bags visible instead of burying them. Felt pads on the hooks stop the rack rattling every time the door shuts. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #NoDrillStorage #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A slim white wire over-the-door basket rack hooked over a pale grey door, its baskets holding rolled cream towels, a woven pouch and a folded linen tote, with a wooden-handled brush on a side hook.

pins.head: PAPER DOWN, THEN POUR
pins.sub: A Station You Can Throw Away
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Tips: Tape Paper Down Before You Open Anything
pins.desc: The most useful epoxy resin tips are about the table, not the resin. Tape kraft paper over the whole surface before you open a bottle, so the drips you do not notice leave with the paper instead of curing onto wood. Keep cups, stir sticks and gloves within reach on that paper, and set a clean box lid nearby to drop over the piece while it cures. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #EpoxyResin #CraftRoom
pins.alt: A narrow side table covered edge to edge in kraft paper taped down with blue painter's tape, a thin disposable glove laid flat on it, a roll of blue tape beside the glove, and a clear mixing cup and a glass jar of wooden stir sticks further back.

pins.head: AIR DRY, DON'T WIPE
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: Wash Molds Gently So They Stay Glossy
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners goes wrong at cleanup more often than at the pour. The inside of a silicone mold is a polished surface, and anything abrasive leaves a haze that every piece afterwards copies. Rinse with warm water and a soft brush, stand the mold up to air dry instead of wiping it with a towel that sheds lint, and store it flat so the walls keep their shape. Contains affiliate links. #ResinMolds #ResinCrafts #DIYCrafts
pins.alt: A clear silicone mold tray propped to drain on a bamboo rack beside a white kitchen sink with water beads still on it, a soft brush lying next to it, and a cured clear resin disc resting on a folded sage cloth.

pins.head: ROLL IT OUT OF THE GAP
pins.title: Small Apartment Organization: Measure the Narrow Gap Before You Shop
pins.desc: Small apartment organization often comes down to one gap nobody uses. Measure the width, the depth and the height of the slot beside a cabinet or appliance first, then subtract a little so the trolley still rolls out without scraping. Casters matter more than shelves here, because a cart you have to lift out is a cart you stop using after a week. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #KitchenStorage #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A slim chrome rolling cart pulled halfway out of the narrow gap between cream kitchen cabinets, holding folded cloths, two glass jars of dried pasta and a woven basket, with a wooden spoon on the counter above.

pins.head: PICK THE GRAB YOU NEED
pins.sub: Hot Glue, White Glue or Tape
pins.title: Hot Glue Gun Tips: Match the Adhesive to What You Are Sticking
pins.desc: Most hot glue gun tips start with one honest point: hot glue grabs fast and holds thick, uneven things, but it stays slightly flexible and shows as a bead. White craft glue dries clear and flat on paper and fabric but needs a clip and time. Double-sided tape is the one to reach for when the join has to be invisible and takes no load at all. Contains affiliate links. #CraftSupplies #GlueGun #CraftRoom
pins.alt: A black glue gun resting nose-down on a small white dish with a clear glue stick beside it, a plain white bottle of craft glue, a roll of clear tape, and two wood offcuts held together with a metal spring clip on a sheet of parchment.
